column4: A stylised AAA 3D video game screenshot, in-engine render, cinematic 16:9 frame, no UI, no HUD, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no boat names or lettering painted on any hull (all hulls plain glossy colour), no watermark. Art style: chunky toy-like nautical world in glossy painted enamel and varnished timber, bold readable silhouettes, soft bevelled edges, saturated signal colours (signal red, sunflower yellow, cobalt blue, enamel white, varnished teak, brass), like a premium hand-painted toy regatta caught in a storm. A saturated stylised sea of deep teal to emerald with cream-white foam crests and spray, never grey. Chunky toy-proportioned captains with big heads, oversized hands and boots, and big hats. Keep the main subject composed in the CENTRE THIRD of the frame. Scene: violet dusk storm, slanting rain. A glossy cobalt blue toy yacht cresting a big emerald wave in the centre; its chunky captain holds a jousting lance straight up and a bright cyan lightning bolt strikes the lance tip, the lance glowing electric cyan with St Elmo's fire sparks. Bruised violet and indigo clouds, a thin band of gold sunset light on the horizon, cream foam on the wave, cyan light reflecting on the wet deck and water.
